Case reference: 2015006607.CaseDesc: Russell Peter Yellowbird was reported missing by his family in February 2015 after they became concerned that he had been out of contact for an extended period. It is believed that his last known location was in the downtown area of Edmonton, Alberta. Given the unusual circumstances of his disappearance, there are concerns for his well-being. There are no indications to suggest any foul play.

Shirt: Red, White, Red with white flowers
Shoes: Canvas, Brown, "North Star" Brand, running shoes

Case reference: 2020008388.CaseDesc: On December 10, 1982, David Templar was seen for the last time when he was picked up by his father for a visitation. David was to be returned home to his mother on December 12, but never returned. It is believed that his father may have brought him to India.

He was reported missing when his wife returned home in the late afternoon and discovered he was not home. The dogs were located later the same day wandering the streets approximately 1 km from his residence. Curtis has not been seen since and the dog leash has not been located.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, a ship and names Lauren, John and Cliff on boat
Torso (Back), 3 roses with names of Michelle, Kietan and Kayla

Case reference: 2014001591.CaseDesc: On September 5, 1997, Gordon Mertz was seen for the last time at the Department of Fisheries and Oceans (DFO) on East White Hills road in St. John's, Newfoundland. Gordon worked as a Fisheries Scientist, and records show that he logged off of his computer and left the building shortly after 5:15 p.m.

Case reference: 2014002519.CaseDesc: Denis Beauchamp was last seen on April 18, 1977 in Montreal, Quebec. Denis went to his sister's house after an argument with his boyfriend. Denis stayed there for a few days, and then left without giving any more news.

Case reference: 2014002963.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1990, Nicholas Leonard was seen for the last time rowing a homemade kayak towards the north end of Lower Loon Lake in the town of Wabush, Newfoundland & Labrador.

Case reference: 2012020087.CaseDesc: James Carlson was last seen between 7:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m. on 5 May 2010 at a local business in Watrous, Saskatchewan. His 1985 Chevrolet Monte Carlo was found nearly 125 kilometres north in a rural area south of Rosthern Sk. Police have yet to locate James.

Hair: Brown, Balding in front , longer in back
Teeth: Visible Missing, Missing Left upper front tooth

Case reference: 2014005390.CaseDesc: On November 10,  2009, Victoria Chan was seen for the last time in Chilliwack, British Columbia. Victoria was engaged in a high risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014006177.CaseDesc: On October 9, 1987, around 9:00 p.m., Phillip Orvis took his boat out on Lake Winnipeg from Matheson Island in Manitoba. He was on his way to his fishing camp on Black Bear Island. By the time he left, the water on the lake was very rough. Phillip could not swim and was known to never wear a life jacket. His boat was found the next day. It was full of water and was drifting towards the mainland about 1 Km south-east of the dock from which he is believed to have left. Land, air and water searches were carried out, as well as dragging operations on the lake, but his body was never found. Phillip is presumed to have drowned and foul play is not suspected.

Case reference: 2013000098.CaseDesc: On September 5, 1974, eight men were on a drilling barge. As they were making no headway against a strong current, it was agreed upon to park the barge for the night. The eight men worked together to park the vessel however one of the legs failed to lower, causing the barge to tip. Donald Bradburn was amongst the men who were thrown from the barge. Despite dragging operations Donald has never been located.

Case reference: 2014005451.CaseDesc: John W. Burton and two passengers (Clifford Dowson and Edward Flett) were flying from Oxford House to Island Lake in Manitoba. John Burton was the pilot of the Cessna 185 and at approximately 11:00 a.m. he made a routine radio call stating that the plane would be landing at Garden Hill in approximately 15 minutes. The plane never arrived at its destination. The wreckage and all three souls on board were never located.

Case reference: 2021030286.CaseDesc: On May 13, 2021, Mona Hu was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Mona had been in contact with her family in China, and was arranging to travel to see them.

Case reference: 2014005821.CaseDesc: Jacques Joseph Duguay was reported missing on May 31, 1982 from Saint John, New Brunswick. On May 25th, 1982, his vehicle, a 1975 Chevrolet half-ton pickup truck was towed from Berry Mills highway just outside Moncton, New Brunswick. The vehicle had been there since May 21st, 1982.

Case reference: 2014004511.CaseDesc: On July 29, 2004 George Davis left a residence near Creston, BC to get cigarettes. He was driving a 1981 brown Chrysler Lebaron with a British Columbia licence plate. The vehicle has not been recovered.

Mark: Eyes, Mole lower lid right eye

Case reference: 2013000025.CaseDesc: Darwin Sylvester was last seen at approximately 11 p.m. on May 28, 1998, in Brandon, Manitoba. He contacted his partner shortly after 12:00 a.m. on May 29th to inform her of his intention to meet with an associate for breakfast; however, he failed to attend the meeting. All of his personal belongings and luggage were located at a residence on Chalmers Road. We have not been able to establish any contact with Darwin since that time.

Tattoo: Left Arm, "Spartans MC in Memory of" (text)

Case reference: 2014004591.CaseDesc: In July 2004, Philip Leishman left his residence with a friend from Kakisa Lake, Northwest Territories. Philip had told his family that he would be travelling to Fort McMurray, Alberta, and it was confirmed that he was in Fort McMurray until late August of 2004. Philip has ties to Port Alberni, British Columbia, Grande Prairie, Alberta, and Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2017061282.CaseDesc: Andrew Fraser was last seen near the falls in Niagara Falls, Ontario, on March 23, 1999.

Case reference: 2008003699.CaseDesc: Gary Anderson and his wife Dawn were camping and fishing on Kilburn Lake in Woodland Caribou Provincial Park.  Gary went out fishing on the lake alone in his canoe and never returned. A search by land, water and air turned up only a fishing lure and a hat.

Case reference: 2014006454.CaseDesc: Jonathan Jay Wood was last seen in November 2013, in Abbotsford, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014005549.CaseDesc: At the end of September 2010, Dustin McMillan left Edmonton to drive to Ontario. Police have not been able to confirm where and when Dustin was last seen but he never made it to his final destination.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, High TI style tattoo

Case reference: 2014004607.CaseDesc: George Robichaud was last seen by his roommate on March 15, 2005, at their home in Moncton, New Brunswick. George was suffering from mental health issues at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2016068711.CaseDesc: On September 30, 1969, an unidentified male was found 0.8 kilometres west of Sioux Lookout. His death appears to be self-inflicted

Case reference: 2019033665.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1988, the remains of a male were found in a field on the side of road 132 in Tracy, Québec. A camp was found near the remains.

Case reference: 2014005441.CaseDesc: On April 23, 2010, Roland Enabulele was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Roland had taken a trip to Spain and has last spoken with his ex-wife on May 3. During that conversation, Roland advised her that he would be returning to Toronto on May 5, but never returned.

Case reference: 2014002108.CaseDesc: On August 18, 1978, Craig Waldum took part in a canoeing expedition along the Nelson River in Gillam, Manitoba, with seven other people. He was one of two guides on the trip. Three members of the group were on the riverbank. They were guiding the second canoe to shore with a rope. The remaining five members, including Craig, were in the second canoe. While guiding the canoe to shore, they gave the rope some slack. This caused the bow of the canoe to turn out into the current and tip over. Those on the shore were unable to hold onto the rope because of the strength of the current and the canoe was swept downstream. Craig held onto the canoe for a couple of hours, and then he was seen to let go. He slipped under the water and did not resurface. His remains have not been recovered.

Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2014004580.CaseDesc: On the morning of July 23, 1991, a group of 8 individuals left Igloolik, Nunavut and headed to Hall Beach, Nunavut.  The group travelled using a 24 foot freighter canoe powered by a 30 hp outboard motor.  It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2014003161.CaseDesc: On February 4, 1985, Andrew Pasztor was reported missing in Richmond, British Columbia.  Andrew had left home with the family vehicle which was later found at a restaurant in North Vancouver.  Andrew has not been seen or heard from since.

Jacket: Beige, Vinyl with imitation fur collar

The boat was located two days later, swamped near the Narrows and Popular Point. A search was conducted and lasted for over one month without any success in locating Thomas and Lawrence.

Case reference: 2014005581.CaseDesc: On March 23, 2011, at approximately 11:00 p.m., Steven Lapowich was last seen at Pearson International Airport in Toronto, Ontario. Steven boarded a flight to Puerto Rico, but never returned home.

Case reference: 2025052841.CaseDesc: Travis Perlman was reported missing on September 7, 2025 by his family.  He was last seen in Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan on August 7, 2025. There is concern from his family for his well-being.

Sweater: Grey, Black, Dark grey zip-up Nike sweater with a green logo
Tattoo: Right Ear, Numbers "224" below the ear

Case reference: 2023023783.CaseDesc: Nathan Wise was last seen on May 12, 2023, in the area of Jane Street and Sheppard Avenue in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014047277.CaseDesc: On December 16, 2014, at approximately 10:30 a.m., Abdool Kisson was last seen leaving his ex-girlfriend’s house in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2019007309.CaseDesc: On December 12, 2018, Robert Campbell was seen for the last time as he left work in Toronto, Ontario. Robert had not been seen for three months before he was reported missing.

Case reference: 2014006123.CaseDesc: Michael Montgomery was last seen on May 22, 2013, at his residence in Mississauga, Ontario.  He was spotted in the area of HWY 16, Jasper National Park, Alberta at the end of May 2013. It’s possible that he was headed to Edmonton to look for work.

Case reference: 2022064778.CaseDesc: Justin McMillan was last seen at his home in Keswick Ridge, New Brunswick, on December 19th, 2022. Law enforcement has explored numerous avenues to locate Justin with no success.

Jacket: Dark Blue, Puffy style winter jacket
Tattoo: Left Eye, Tear drop and cross

Case reference: 2014005066.CaseDesc: James Douglas Turnball or Turnbull was last seen on the MV Princess of Vancouver vessel commuting from Nanaimo to Vancouver in the waters of the Howe Sound in 1966. Bowen Island RCMP are seeking any next of kin or close relations for the missing male.

Gold, Yellow, Brown, Timex watch with leather strap

Case reference: 2012020139.CaseDesc: On November 15, 1981, 16 year old Myriam Isabelle Kniaz was seen for the last time at the residence of her foster family located in Ste-Foy, Quebec .

Case reference: 2006008799.CaseDesc: Doris Fennell was last observed at the home of an acquaintace in Kitley-Elizabeth Township, near Addison, Ontario. Foul Play is strongly suspected in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014003434.CaseDesc: On the evening of May 18, 1986, Monique Brosseau was seen for the last time at her home in Duhamel-Ouest, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014003060.CaseDesc: Pierre Lagacé was last seen on January 5, 2003, where he was living in the LeMoyne sector of Longueuil, Québec. Pierre was reported missing by a family member and at the time of his disappearance, he had little money and no car in his name.

Case reference: 2019052051.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2019, at approximately 4:00 am, Brandon Pollock was seen for the last time at his family residence in Hamilton, Ontario. The men approached the swimmer, who was later identified as Brandon Pollock, to confirm his wellbeing. Brandon had told them that he was okay and advised them to pass by.

Case reference: 2014004773.CaseDesc: On August 10, 2000, Basel El Youssef, originally from Lebanon, was seen for the last time when he left his mother’s residence in the Saint-Léonard District of Montreal, Quebec. Bassel has not been seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2014005006.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2007, Sun Jin, her husband Joon Han, and their daughter Il Han were seen for the last time at a school in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2023009705.CaseDesc: Paul Davis was last seen on November 5, 2022 when he went swimming off of the shores of Saint John West near the Bay Ferry dock in Saint John, New Brunswick.

Case reference: 2024017730.CaseDesc: Adair Townsend was reported missing on April 8, 2024 at 7:00 p.m. in New Glasgow, Nova Scotia, and had not been seen since approximately noon on the same date. An investigation confirmed that Adair was last seen on CCTV video at the Pictou County Landfill in Mount William, Nova Scotia on April 9, 2024 at 5:26 a.m. Subsequent searches were conducted with the assistance of an RCMP police service dog, helicopter and drone from the Civil Air Search and Rescue Association. To date, no trace of Adair has been found.

Case reference: 2006011299.CaseDesc: Henry Atlookan left Whiteclay Lake in a canoe to travel 55 km to Armstrong, Ontario. He may have been seen on June 25, 1968 making a purchase at a local store in the Town of Armstrong. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2019043680.CaseDesc: On July 29, 2019, Rachid Jalifi left his apartment in West Vancouver, British Columbia and was confirmed to have boarded a flight to Mexico. Rachid was last heard from on July 31, 2019 and has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2017074201.CaseDesc: On August 23, 1995, the remains of an unidentified man were discovered in Lake Ontario, near Cherry Beach, in Toronto, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he may be of European ancestry.

Case reference: 2014005333.CaseDesc: Jack Nutter attended a medical appointment in Moncton, New Brunswick, in June 2007, later leaving and has not been seen since. Police have not been able to confirm any sightings of Jack since his appointment. Jack's family is concerned for his wellbeing.

A large-scale search operation was conducted on land and water, but Raymond was not located. Raymond has considerable expertise in wilderness survival, and has not been seen or heard from  since.

Case reference: 2013000145.CaseDesc: The Calgary Police Service is seeking the public's assistance in locating Ralph Simington. He was last seen in Calgary, Alberta on June 15, 2012.

Case reference: 1996006630.CaseDesc: Adam, Mitchell and Trevor O'Brien have been reported missing since November 9, 1996 from Mount Pearl, Newfoundland & Labrador. The three brothers may be in the company of their father.

Case reference: 2014005011.CaseDesc: On July 28, 2005, at approximately 6:15 p.m., Senekinesh Qirma was seen for the last time at the Eaton Centre in Toronto, Ontario. Senekinesh was in Canada on a visitor’s visa.

Case reference: 2014004116.CaseDesc: Diane Tresham was last seen on March 27, 2000, leaving her residence in Welland, Ontario.  Her vehicle was later located along the Niagara River Parkway.  At that time, Diane was said to be feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2014002341.CaseDesc: On June 23, 1979, Terrence Henderson was last seen canoeing on Lac St. Anne in Ross Haven, Alberta.

Andria was last seen in Grande Prairie, Alberta between July 2010 and September 2010. Case reference: 2014003747.CaseDesc: Karoly John "Charles" Horvath, a visitor from England, arrived in Kelowna BC in early May 1989. All his belongings were left behind at the campground where he had been staying.

Case reference: 2018008636.CaseDesc: On February 6, 2018, at approximately 11:30pm, Guerman Pouchkine was last seen in the area of Steels Avenue West and Keele Street in Toronto, Ontario.

The sacrum was deformed and there is a possibility that he walked with a limp.

Case reference: 2012020046.CaseDesc: On January, 17, 2008, Bradley Worobeck left his place of employment in downtown Calgary and went to a pub that was also in downtown Calgary. That was the last time anyone saw or heard from Bradley.

Case reference: 2025051524.CaseDesc: On November 12 2008, at approximately 11:45 pm, Aren Washburn was last seen on the Rainbow Bridge in Niagara Falls, New York, USA.  At the time of his disappearance, Aren may have been feeling despondent.
